name: maeve-agent
description:
Connect Maeve Social to Claude to analyze social performance, benchmark competitors, and create content across your connected accounts without leaving your conversation. Built for agencies, businesses, creators, and founders, Maeve Social brings your workspace analytics and publishing workflows into Claude so you can turn real performance data into your next posts.

#### What you can do

- **Analyze workspace and account performance:** Review workspace-level summaries or drill into individual connected accounts to spot trends, top drivers, and drop-offs.
- **Compare posts and inspect individual metrics:** Compare post performance across connected accounts, pull metrics for individual posts, and check available audience demographics reported by each network.
- **Track Instagram competitors:** Review benchmark metrics and recent posts from the Instagram competitors you track in Maeve Social to inform what you publish next.
- **Create, review, and schedule content:** Check your calendar, pull from your media library, write or revise drafts, route work through approval workflows, and schedule upcoming posts.
- **Prepare paid campaigns with human approval:** Set up and review paid campaigns in Claude, with human approval required before any campaign launches or spends budget.

#### Example questions to ask

- "How did this workspace perform over the last 30 days, and which connected account drove the biggest lift?"
- "Compare our top five posts across all connected accounts this month and break down the metrics on the #1 post."
- "What audience demographics are available for our connected accounts right now, and where is engagement strongest?"
- "Review benchmark metrics and recent posts from our tracked Instagram competitors, then draft three post ideas using assets from our media library."
- "What is on the calendar for next week, and which drafts are still waiting for approval?"
- "Prepare a paid campaign for our best-performing post from this week so my team can review and approve it."
